api_key_field.description: Dedicated staging inbound credential only. Never use the PBK bridge master or Composio project API key.

requiredChecksBeforeEnablement: Authenticated workspace billing confirms the private Custom MCP capability
No existing private registration for this exact user and MCP URL; reuse a verified existing registration instead of creating a duplicate
Exact isolated staging host, strict three-tool server and distinct dedicated inbound credential
Private toolkit access is user-only; never substitute user_id all
Connected account belongs to the intended project, user and returned private auth configuration
Synchronized tools are exactly the expected three metadata tools with strict zero-input schemas
Create a separate session restricted to the returned private toolkit/account/three actual tool slugs; disable search, connection management, workbench, proxy, multi-account and multi-execute
Perform actual metadata reads through Composio and verify hosted readiness, denied writes/extra arguments, no secret or raw state exposure, and unchanged business collections

credentialPolicy.source: Existing separately generated staging inbound credential through protected server configuration
